dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave spline fitting the trailing edge from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Ratio of approximately 1.3:1 measured from the maximum base width to the vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large-radius structural convexity forming a smooth arc on the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick visible beak extending anteriorly from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions to the rostrum.
